label: WhatsApp Business
terms_note: Business accounts only (WhatsApp Business Platform, Meta app with whatsapp_business_messaging + whatsapp_business_management, system-user token). POST graph.facebook.com/v{N}/{PHONE_NUMBER_ID}/messages: free-form text / media / interactive inside the 24 h customer-service window opened by the user's message; outside it 'template messages are the only type of message that can be sent'. Templates: POST /{WABA_ID}/message_templates, categories authentication / marketing / utility, automatic review → APPROVED / REJECTED, 250 templates per WABA unverified → 6,000 verified, 100 template creations / hour, quality rating can pause or disable a template. Messaging limits (business-initiated unique contacts / 24 h): 250 → 2,000 (scaling path: business verification or 2,000 delivered high-quality templates in 30 d) → 10,000 → 100,000 → unlimited (automatic scaling on quality + ≥50 % utilisation). Throughput up to 80 messages / second per number by default, upgradable; pair rate limit 1 message per 6 s to the same user (bursts to 45 / 6 s). Inbound + statuses are webhook-only (X-Hub-Signature-256). Per-delivered-message pricing by category.

sdks: Meta Graph API — Business SDKs (PHP, Python, Node, Java, Ruby); Cloud API is plain HTTPS (developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api)

endpoints.notes: "the only type of message that can be sent outside a customer service window"

endpoints.call: Groups (registry note 2026-09-02: OBA required, ≤ 8 participants, 10,000 groups / number)

reference.limits: - Business-initiated unique contacts / 24 h: 250 (new) → 2,000 (scaling path: business verification or 2,000 delivered high-quality templates in 30 days) → 10,000 → 100,000 → unlimited (automatic scaling: high quality + ≥ 50 % utilisation over 7 days). Throughput up to 80 mps per number by default, upgradable; pair rate limit 1 message / 6 s to the same user (burst 45 / 6 s). - Pricing per delivered template by category; service messages inside the window free (client docstring, 2026-09-02). - Opt-in required for business-initiated templates (Meta policy); quality rating drives limits.

fields.name: access_token
fields.help: System user access token or business token of the WhatsApp Business Account (whatsapp_business_messaging, whatsapp_business_management), sent as `Authorization: Bearer` as in every Cloud API example (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/messages/text-messages).

config_fields.name: phone_number_id
config_fields.help: WhatsApp business phone number ID (not the phone number itself, e.g. 106540352242922; GET /<WABA_ID>/phone_numbers lists them). Every call goes to /<phone_number_id>/... Env: PLATFORM_MCP_WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID.

me.note: GET /{phone_number_id}?fields=id,display_phone_number,verified_name,quality_rating,status: the business phone number the token sends from.

send.note: POST /{phone_number_id}/messages {messaging_product: whatsapp, recipient_type: individual, to, type: text, text: {body}} answers {contacts[{input, wa_id}], messages[{id: wamid...}]}. `to` is the user's phone number (e.g. +16505551234); body up to 4096 characters. Free-form text only reaches users inside the 24-hour customer service window; outside it only approved template messages can be sent (not mapped). `subject`/`channel` are ignored.

mark_read.note: POST /{phone_number_id}/messages {messaging_product: whatsapp, status: read, message_id} answers {success: true}. `message_id` (the wamid from the incoming-message webhook) is REQUIRED by WhatsApp; 'When you mark a message as read, the API also marks earlier messages in the conversation as read'; within 30 days of receipt. `thread_id` is not used.

not_offered.list_inbound: Incoming messages arrive only through the messages webhook ('When you receive a message webhook indicating an incoming message', https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/guides/mark-message-as-read); the Cloud API has no message-history read endpoint.
not_offered.get_thread: No conversation-history endpoint exists; message content is delivered only by webhooks (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/webhooks).
not_offered.reply: A reply is a send to the user's phone number with an optional context.message_id; the Messages API needs `to` ('WhatsApp user phone number', https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/messages/text-messages), which the reply verb does not carry. Use send.

evidence: host graph.facebook.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
